mechanism.forced_participant: Passive quote/liquidity providers on the three USD-perp books who withdraw or widen quotes into the scheduled 8:30 ET CPI print because carrying inventory through a known high-variance data release violates their inventory/VaR limits. They are forced by the SCHEDULE (a public, exogenous, census-evidenced instant), not by any endogenous price/OI/funding state.
mechanism.late_participant: Slow followers of the inflation surprise: systematic risk-off/re-risk flows (vol-targeting and CTA-style rebalancers reacting to the print over hours, not seconds) and discretionary post-print traders, executing through the US morning after the release.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: The CPI print resolves wide ex-ante disagreement about the inflation path (no pre-committed outcome exists). At 8:30 ET the release hits books thinned by schedule-forced provider withdrawal; one-sided informed taker flow meets the thin book, so the initial repricing is partial. As providers re-quote and late participants execute over the following hours, the announcement bar's direction continues instead of instantly clearing. The observable is the announcement bar's reaction sign -- the market's own revealed summary of the surprise direction (no consensus-forecast series exists in evidence; the price reaction IS the surprise proxy).
why_inflation_information_differs_from_p: information type: an FOMC decision instant resolves a largely PRE-ANCHORED expectation (forward-guided, Fed-funds-futures-priced, 8 scheduled decisions/year on Wednesdays); a CPI print is a genuine information shock with wide ex-ante disagreement about the level -- the reaction is a pure information repricing, which is why the ng2 plan names different information as the declared basis

channel: a policy decision acts on the nominal discount rate directly; an inflation print moves the REAL-rate path and the risk-appetite composite WITHOUT any policy action -- crypto perps are long-duration, real-rate-sensitive risk assets, so the CPI surprise hits them through a different pricing kernel than a decision does

clock structure: 8:30 ET morning print landing after the overnight/Asia session on continuously-open 24/7 books, vs the dead forms' 14:00 ET post-US-open decision instants; different hour-of-day liquidity state, different calendar week (CPI week vs FOMC week never coincide in this window -- the census dates are disjoint from the 8 FOMC instants)

this is a DECLARED basis, not an asserted immunity: D2 measures pooled |rho| <= 0.20 of this exact representation vs the 29-shape veto panel AND the dead FOMC-form shadows; if the CPI book is the same shape on different dates, F3 fires and the re-clocking interpretation is measured-true
when_it_must_fail: if crypto participants fully pre-position into the print, the announcement bar's reaction sign carries no residual information: anchor after-cost expectancy statistically indistinguishable from zero

if H1 reaction-sign continuation is generically autocorrelated with no clock needed, the shifted-calendar placebo reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) and the family is falsified as a re-clocking
if the book is a bare clock artifact, the clock-only shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it
if the book is the dead FOMC/dvol-shock/tsmom shape on new dates, D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vetoes it before selection (the 0.44087/0.432014/0.416883 precedent is the named kill-candidate)
if a 2-bar delayed entry does at least as well as the instant entry, the print-instant timing carries nothing (F7)

if the clairvoyant control cannot express positive after-cost expectancy at tier 2.0, no directional edge is expressible on this substrate at H=6 and the battery is a null battery (F6, INVALID_NULL -- not a mechanism falsification)

observable_pinned.definition: reaction sign: d = sign(r_A) with r_A = last_price(A)/last_price(A-1) - 1 computed on the announcement bar A(s) of the frozen S4 panel
observable_pinned.instant_source: p0_calendar_census_ng2.json instants (series US-MACRO/BLS_CPI_RELEASE), DST-correct UTC per the 8:30 America/New_York print clock

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels; bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.announcement_bar: A(s) = the H1 bar whose [T, T+1h) interval contains instant_utc: hour_utc == instant_utc floored to the hour (12:30:00Z -> bar '<date>T12'; 13:30:00Z -> bar '<date>T13'); the release lands 30 minutes into A
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A(s) (T+1h), the first bar close strictly after the instant at which the full announcement bar is point-in-time
clock.entry_bar: A(s)+1, the first bar whose open boundary is strictly after the instant; entry fill = last_price of bar A(s) (the last trade observed at the decision close, the ng1 fill convention)
clock.instant_alignment: UTC, DST-correct from the census (8:30 EDT = 12:30Z; 8:30 EST = 13:30Z); no FOMC and no NFP instant exists in this proposal's grid

warmup.rule: an instant is eligible only if (i) >= 24 H1 bars exist in the symbol's panel before the instant's date, (ii) bars A-1 and A exist, (iii) the exit bar A+H exists within panel bounds; any miss drops the instant fail-closed with a recorded reason
warmup.coverage: panel starts 2025-08-22T00; earliest CPI instant 2025-09-11 has 492 bars before its announcement bar A (480 before its date); latest CPI instant 2026-08-12T12:30Z has its A+12 exit bar at 2026-08-13T00, well inside the 2026-08-21T23 panel end; therefore ALL 11 instants x 3 symbols are eligible, zero dropped
warmup.signal_history: none required (anchor direction uses bar A and A-1 only; no thresholds, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters)

columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used for the reaction return r_A (bars A-1 -> A), the entry fill (bar A) and the exit fill (bar A+H)

features_lags.lag_structure: two-bar price feature at lags -1 and 0 relative to the decision (r_A spans bars A-1 close to A close); exit at lag +H (A+H close). No other lags, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters.

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = sign(r_A) = sign(last_price(A)/last_price(A-1) - 1); exact tie r_A == 0 -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped); missing/empty last_price on A-1 or A -> decision recorded UNMEASURED_BAR, dropped fail-closed with count
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of A(s) (= open of A+1), fill price = last_price of bar A(s), unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of A(s)+H, fill price = last_price of bar A(s)+H; no stop, no early exit
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0)

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption via ng1; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.

anchor.rule: direction = sign(r_A) on bar A; H = 6 bars
anchor.decisions: 11 CPI instants x 3 symbols = 33 funded decisions (minus exact-tie/unmeasured skips, expected 0)

neighbour.rule: identical direction rule and grid; H = 12 bars
neighbour.mechanism_support: if inflation-surprise continuation is real, the longer horizon must retain the sign with graceful decay; a horizon cliff or sign flip contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

delay_pair_control.rule: identical direction rule (still computed on bar A) and grid; BOTH fills shifted +2 bars: entry fill = last_price(A+2), exit fill = last_price(A+2+H), H = 6; horizon length preserved
delay_pair_control.purpose: tests print-instant timing specificity: under-reaction continuation decays as late participants execute, so a 2-hour-delayed entry must not dominate the instant entry; the identifiability logic of Q-4 (a control that cannot move the signal would be an INVALID NULL)

clairvoyant_control.rule: identical grid, holds (H = 6), costs and books; direction = sign(last_price(A+H)/last_price(A) - 1) (perfect foresight of the holding-window return); exact tie -> UNFUNDED_SKIP
clairvoyant_control.purpose: machinery validity ceiling: measures the maximum expressible directional edge of the exact fill/cost pipeline; gross expectancy is mechanically >= 0 by construction, so a non-positive AFTER-COST clairvoyant expectancy proves the substrate cannot express any edge at H=6 under tier-2.0 costs (F6 INVALID_NULL); never promotable, never a rescue pool

clock_only_shadow.rule: identical decision grid, holds (H = 6), costs and books; direction = +1 at EVERY decision (pure CPI-clock long exposure carrying zero panel information)
clock_only_shadow.purpose: isolates what the bare exogenous clock yields; if the anchor is subsumed by this exposure the mechanism claim is empty

shifted_calendar_placebo.rule: sham CPI clock: each session index i shifted +1 (session i's decision row placed at session i+1's census instant, DST-correct by construction because the target instant is itself a census instant -- no timestamp fabricated); session 1's row has no predecessor target -> 10 sham instants x 3 symbols = 30 decisions; everything else identical to anchor (H = 6)
shifted_calendar_placebo.sign_freeze: the shift sign is frozen at +1 session (k=+1); the -1 variant is NOT a rescue pool and may never be substituted after any number is visible (P-15); a sham that cannot move the signal is recorded as an identifiability failure, never remediated by flipping k
shifted_calendar_placebo.identifiability: the sham moves instants to real alternate trading days with real microstructure (Q-11 satisfied); it CAN move the signal

arms.pairwise_distinctness: the six arms differ by (direction rule, H, fill timing, instant map) and will carry distinct arm_config_digests at D2/I time; no two arms share all four

representation_identity.p12_statement: This block IS the representation D2 must measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 on. Representation identity = measurement identity (FXFV9 lesson: no undisclosed variant grids, no monthly-grid maps).
representation_identity.grid: H1 rows keyed (symbol, hour_utc) from the three frozen S4 panels (digests pinned in p0_gate.json s4_repin); decision grid = 33 rows keyed (symbol, instant) over the 11 census CPI instants
representation_identity.signal_computation: per decision row: r_A = last_price(A)/last_price(A-1) - 1; d = sign(r_A); entry = last_price(A); exit = last_price(A+H); A = the bar containing the census instant
representation_identity.per_decision_return: r = d * (exit/entry - 1), gross; after-cost r_net = r - 2 * fill_cost_tier2.0 / unit_notional
series_d2_measures: the 33-row per-decision after-cost return vector of ANCHOR (primary)
the same vectors for NEIGH-H12 for the ancestry panel
representation_identity.books: per-symbol books and the pooled 3-symbol book; equal unit notional per decision; no cross-sectional ranking, no normalization across symbols
representation_identity.no_hidden_variants: no alternate k for the sham (k=+1 is THE frozen shift), no alternate sign rule, no horizon outside the declared grid {6, 12}, no alternate span, no monthly aggregation, no sign-flipped re-computation exists or may be substituted at D2; any re-measure must use exactly this representation or be recorded as a NEW proposal

ancestry_defense: PRIMARY named enemies are the two dead ng1 FOMC-instant forms this cycle's plan section 1 designates as kill-candidates. (1) CNG1-A4-P1 (FOMC announcement-bar imb continuation) died at D2 with anchor worst |rho| 0.44087 vs generic_dvol_shock, 0.432014 vs close_displace_fade, 0.416883 vs tsmom28: its book was a generic post-print volatility-shape exposure on the policy clock. P1 differs at the OBSERVABLE layer (price reaction-sign, not taker imbalance) AND at the INFORMATION layer (an unresolved inflation level vs a pre-anchored policy decision) AND at the clock layer (11 census CPI instants, disjoint dates from the 8 FOMC instants); D2 measures this exact representation against those shadows and the 29-shape panel -- no asserted immunity. (2) CNG1-A4-P2 (pre-pressure realization drift, worst 0.398776 vs close_displace_fade): P1 uses no pre-instant accumulation window at all (its only lags are A-1 -> A, the reaction itself). (3) Generic ancestors: WKNDLIQ was measured to BE a low-liquidity-level exposure (0.5628 vs dvol proxies) -- P1 conditions on no liquidity LEVEL, no weekday, no session; FUNDJUMP carried the funding LEVEL (0.2439) -- P1 consumes no funding, no OI; ATTN-PHASE was a recurring US-session phase -- P1's clock is 11 non-recurring exogenous print instants; CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE and RUNPERSIST are dead at any clock as endogenous boundary forms -- P1 neither fades a displacement nor persists a run, and the sham + clock-shadow + delay controls exist precisely to falsify any re-clocking or generic-drift interpretation.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P1's information source is the CPI print (inflation state) with a PRICE-layer observable (reaction sign from last_price); sibling CNG2-A4-P2 uses the NFP print (labor state) with a FLOW-layer observable (announcement-bar taker-quote imbalance). Different information series AND different observable layer, not a parameter swap. The two decision grids are date-disjoint by census arithmetic (11 CPI dates intersect 11 NFP dates in 0 days), so F5 is expected NOT_COMPUTABLE_GRID_DISJOINT and D2 must record the disjointness proof from the census.

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 or F7 fires, the CPI clock carries no incremental information beyond generic H1 reaction-sign continuation and the inflation-clock family is dead on this substrate -- it must NOT be re-shifted to other k or re-clocked. If F3 fires against the FOMC-form shadows, the plan's declared basis (inflation information differs from policy information) is measured-false: the CPI book is the dead FOMC shape on new dates, and by plan section 1 the whole inflation/labor-clock frontier loses its primary defense -- both A4 proposals die together. If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow/delay also lose), it is a plain negative: inflation-surprise under-reaction either does not exist at H1 granularity on these three books or is fully eaten by measured tier-2.0 costs. If F6 fires, the substrate cannot express any directional edge at this horizon and the negative-first verdict is recorded as untestable, not as mechanism death. Every outcome feeds CRYPTO_NG2_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
